name: Adam Looking for Eve
overview: Ádám keresi Évát is the Hungarian adaptation of the internationally recognized dating reality format Adam Looking for Eve. Set in a secluded tropical location, the series follows single men and women as they meet for the first time without the influence of modern distractions or material possessions. Living together in nature, participants form connections, face unexpected arrivals, and navigate attraction, trust, and compatibility as their relationships evolve.
